journey.title: A tired evening
journey.purpose: From the next meal to a lower-effort alternative in one action, with cost and effort tradeoffs visible and dependent groceries recalculated, without giving a reason.

steps.intent: See the next meal immediately with its reason and known metrics.
Ask for less effort and compare eligible alternatives ranked for minimal active effort.
Select an alternative that still passes every required rule and equipment constraint.
See the recalculated grocery requirements and which prices remain unknown.

claims.statement: A swap can be requested and completed without giving a reason and without changing permanent priorities.
Alternatives that fail a required rule are separated and not selectable as compliant recommendations.
